title: R' Yehudah bar Karpus

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 35b, according to the reading of the She'iltot, parashat Bo; and our reading there is R' Yehoshua ben Kafosai.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman gives Berakhot 35b. The parallel is in [Bekhorot 35b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.35b.5), where the rule about two witnesses for a firstborn animal is Rabbi Yehoshua ben Kefusai’s. The linked [She’iltot, Bo 44:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Sheiltot_d'Rav_Achai_Gaon.44.3) (Vilna 1861) ascribes the same rule to Rabbi Yehudah ben Karpusi.

[Heilprin’s entry on Rabbi Yehoshua ben Kefusai](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1764&lang=en) also cites this baraita in Bekhorot. Hyman’s heading gives Yehudah bar Karpus. The witnesses preserve distinct names for the same ruling.
